definitions.explanation: The act of managing limited resources (especially money or time) through careful planning and effort. Implies making things work despite constraints.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家計|かけい}→家計：12287_kakei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧やりくり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧やりくり⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}している→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
examples.english: I'm juggling my time to make room for studying.

examples.japanese: ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧やりくり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧だ。
examples.english: My salary is low, so managing finances every month is tough.

notes:
USAGE:
やりくり is most commonly used for household budgeting and financial management but can also apply to time and schedule management. It always implies resourcefulness under constraints.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- やりくり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to manage, to make do
- ⟦{家計|かけい}→家計：12287_kakei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧やりくり: household budget management
- やりくり⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧: good at managing money
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧やりくり: time management

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{節約|せつやく}→節約：03302_setsuyaku⟧ means "economizing" or "saving" and focuses on cutting costs. やりくり is broader — it means managing overall, including finding creative solutions to make ends meet.
